posts.title: The Nintendo 64 Renaissance
posts.description: The Nintendo 64 marked its 30th birthday this past June, and yet despite its age, work on the platform has seen a resurgence over the last decade. The N64’s passionate fan community of software developers, hardware hackers, and reverse engineers have made improvements to many aspects of the system.
